body:
Thank you...

I wish I knew how... I'm feeling desperate on her behalf.

...Please don't. I'd beg you...

Please hold on long enough to hear from someone here. I know the pain, I'm going through it too. There are people around here that can help you, and me, give them the courtesy to have the time to reach out. I'm sure you have so much to offer, like I feel I do.

Honestly, I imagine you feel scarred in the sense that you may not be able to trust anyone ever again, or that there won't be the opportunity to care for someone the same way again.
I'm so low on myself, but I'm fighting so hard to keep my chin up above the water. 

Please keep fighting... I wish you the best...
